---
title: "Album Cover Similarity"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
    page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)

pop_albums <- read_csv("pop_albums.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

album_catalog <- pop_albums |>
  mutate(
    hex_clean = sub("^#", "", hex_color),
    r = strtoi(substr(hex_clean, 1, 2), 16L) / 255,
    g = strtoi(substr(hex_clean, 3, 4), 16L) / 255,
    b_val = strtoi(substr(hex_clean, 5, 6), 16L) / 255,
    b_norm = brightness / 100,
    s_norm = saturation / 100,
    c_norm = contrast / 100
  ) |>
  transmute(
    id = row_number(),
    artist,
    album,
    year,
    genre,
    cover = cover_full,
    thumb = cover_thumbnail,
    hex = hex_color,
    palette,
    r = round(r, 3),
    g = round(g, 3),
    b = round(b_val, 3),
    bright = round(b_norm, 3),
    sat = round(s_norm, 3),
    contrast = round(c_norm, 3)
  )

json_payload <- toJSON(album_catalog, auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: json-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

cat('<script type="application/json" id="album-similarity-data">\n')
cat(json_payload)
cat('\n</script>\n')
```

```{=html}
<script>
function initAlbumComparison() {
  const dataElement = document.getElementById("album-similarity-data");
  if (!dataElement) return;
  const albumData = JSON.parse(dataElement.textContent);

  const searchInput = document.getElementById("search-input");
  const albumDatalist = document.getElementById("album-datalist");
  const genrePicker = document.getElementById("genre-picker");
  const artistPicker = document.getElementById("artist-picker");
  const albumPicker = document.getElementById("album-picker");
  const metricPicker = document.getElementById("metric-picker");
  const scopePicker = document.getElementById("scope-picker");
  const countPicker = document.getElementById("count-picker");
  const surpriseBtn = document.getElementById("btn-surprise");
  const selectedCard = document.getElementById("selected-card");
  const mostCards = document.getElementById("most-similar-cards");
  const leastCards = document.getElementById("least-similar-cards");
  const matchPoolLabel = document.getElementById("match-pool-label");
  const inspectorContent = document.getElementById("inspector-content");
  const inspectorBadge = document.getElementById("inspector-overall-badge");
  const palettePills = document.querySelectorAll(".palette-pill");

  let activePaletteFilter = "all";

  // Populate search datalist
  if (albumDatalist) {
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    albumData.forEach(item => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = `${item.artist} - ${item.album}`;
      frag.appendChild(opt);
    });
    albumDatalist.appendChild(frag);
  }

  function getFilteredArtists(selectedGenre, selectedPalette) {
    let pool = albumData;
    if (selectedGenre && selectedGenre !== "all") {
      pool = pool.filter(a => a.genre === selectedGenre);
    }
    if (selectedPalette && selectedPalette !== "all") {
      pool = pool.filter(a => a.palette === selectedPalette);
    }
    return Array.from(new Set(pool.map(a => a.artist))).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }

  function populateArtists(selectedGenre, defaultArtist) {
    artistPicker.innerHTML = "";
    const artists = getFilteredArtists(selectedGenre, activePaletteFilter);

    if (artists.length === 0) {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.textContent = "No artists in this filter";
      artistPicker.appendChild(opt);
      return;
    }

    artists.forEach((name, idx) => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = name;
      opt.textContent = name;
      if (defaultArtist ? name === defaultArtist : idx === 0) {
        opt.selected = true;
      }
      artistPicker.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }

  function populateAlbumsForArtist(artistName, defaultAlbum) {
    albumPicker.innerHTML = "";
    let list = albumData.filter(a => a.artist === artistName);
    if (activePaletteFilter !== "all") {
      const filtered = list.filter(a => a.palette === activePaletteFilter);
      if (filtered.length > 0) list = filtered;
    }

    list.forEach((item, idx) => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = item.album;
      opt.textContent = item.album;
      if (defaultAlbum ? item.album === defaultAlbum : idx === 0) {
        opt.selected = true;
      }
      albumPicker.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }

  function selectAlbumByName(artistName, albumName) {
    const item = albumData.find(a => a.artist === artistName && a.album === albumName);
    if (item && genrePicker.value !== "all" && item.genre !== genrePicker.value) {
      genrePicker.value = "all";
    }
    populateArtists(genrePicker.value, artistName);
    artistPicker.value = artistName;
    populateAlbumsForArtist(artistName, albumName);
    albumPicker.value = albumName;
    updateDisplay();
  }

  function renderCard(item, targetItem, metric, isMatch) {
    let scoreText = "";
    if (metric === "color") {
      scoreText = `Color: ${(item.colorSim * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
    } else if (metric === "design") {
      scoreText = `Design: ${(item.designSim * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
    } else {
      scoreText = `Match: ${(item.overallSim * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
    }

    const badgeBg = isMatch ? "#dcfce7" : "#fee2e2";
    const badgeColor = isMatch ? "#15803d" : "#b91c1c";

    return `
      <div class="match-card" onclick="window.selectAlbumByName('${item.artist.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', '${item.album.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">
        <img src="${item.cover}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${item.thumb}'" style="width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1/1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; display: block;" alt="${item.album}"/>
        <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; margin-top: 10px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: #0f172a;" title="${item.album}">${item.album}</div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.76rem; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 6px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">${item.artist} (${item.year})</div>
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px;">
          <span class="genre-badge">${item.genre}</span>
          <span style="display: inline-block; background: ${badgeBg}; color: ${badgeColor}; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.74rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px;">
            ${scoreText}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #64748b;">
          <span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:2px;background:${targetItem.hex};border:1px solid #cbd5e1;" title="Target color"></span>
          <span>➔</span>
          <span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:2px;background:${item.hex};border:1px solid #cbd5e1;" title="Match color"></span>
          <span style="font-size: 0.68rem; color: #94a3b8;">${(item.colorSim * 100).toFixed(0)}% col | ${(item.designSim * 100).toFixed(0)}% des</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function updateInspector(target, match) {
    if (!inspectorContent || !match) return;

    if (inspectorBadge) {
      inspectorBadge.textContent = `${(match.overallSim * 100).toFixed(1)}% Match`;
    }

    inspectorContent.innerHTML = `
      <!-- Left: Target Album -->
      <div style="text-align: center;">
        <img src="${target.cover}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${target.thumb}'" style="width: 130px; height: 130px; border-radius: 8px; object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);" alt="${target.album}"/>
        <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 8px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;" title="${target.album}">${target.album}</div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #64748b;">${target.artist}</div>
        <div style="margin-top: 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #f1f5f9; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.72rem;">
          <span style="width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:2px; background:${target.hex}; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; display:inline-block;"></span>
          <code>${target.hex}</code>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Center: Comparative Metric Meters -->
      <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 0 10px;">
        <!-- Color Metric -->
        <div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; color: #1e293b;">
            <span>Color Palette Agreement</span>
            <span style="color: #2563eb;">${(match.colorSim * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="meter-bar-container">
            <div class="meter-bar-fill" style="width: ${(match.colorSim * 100)}%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #6366f1);"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Design Metric -->
        <div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; color: #1e293b;">
            <span>Composition & Design Agreement</span>
            <span style="color: #059669;">${(match.designSim * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="meter-bar-container">
            <div class="meter-bar-fill" style="width: ${(match.designSim * 100)}%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #10b981, #059669);"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Metric Values Breakdown -->
        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 0.74rem;">
          <div>
            <div style="color: #64748b; font-weight: 600;">Brightness</div>
            <div style="color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px;">
              ${(target.bright * 100).toFixed(0)}% vs ${(match.bright * 100).toFixed(0)}%
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div style="color: #64748b; font-weight: 600;">Vibrancy</div>
            <div style="color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px;">
              ${(target.sat * 100).toFixed(0)}% vs ${(match.sat * 100).toFixed(0)}%
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div style="color: #64748b; font-weight: 600;">Contrast</div>
            <div style="color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px;">
              ${(target.contrast * 100).toFixed(0)}% vs ${(match.contrast * 100).toFixed(0)}%
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Right: #1 Matched Album -->
      <div style="text-align: center; cursor: pointer;" onclick="window.selectAlbumByName('${match.artist.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', '${match.album.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')" title="Click to make this the selected album">
        <img src="${match.cover}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${match.thumb}'" style="width: 130px; height: 130px; border-radius: 8px; object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid #10b981; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);" alt="${match.album}"/>
        <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 8px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;" title="${match.album}">${match.album}</div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #64748b;">${match.artist}</div>
        <div style="margin-top: 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #f1f5f9; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.72rem;">
          <span style="width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:2px; background:${match.hex}; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; display:inline-block;"></span>
          <code>${match.hex}</code>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function updateDisplay() {
    const artistName = artistPicker.value;
    const albumName = albumPicker.value;
    const metric = metricPicker.value;
    const scope = scopePicker.value;
    const count = parseInt(countPicker.value, 10) || 3;
    
    const target = albumData.find(a => a.artist === artistName && a.album === albumName);
    if (!target) return;

    selectedCard.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 800; color: #2563eb; letter-spacing: 0.06em;">Selected Album</span>
        <span class="genre-badge" style="background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; font-weight: 700;">${target.genre}</span>
      </div>
      <img src="${target.cover}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${target.thumb}'" style="width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1/1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; display: block;" alt="${target.album}"/>
      <h3 style="margin: 14px 0 4px 0; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; text-align: center;">${target.album}</h3>
      <div style="font-size: 0.92rem; color: #64748b; font-weight: 500; text-align: center;">${target.artist} &bull; ${target.year}</div>

      <!-- Extracted Visual Profile -->
      <div style="margin-top: 14px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px;">
        <div style="font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 6px;">Visual Profile</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px;">
          <span style="display:inline-block; width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:4px; background:${target.hex}; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"></span>
          <span style="font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #1e293b;">${target.palette}</span>
          <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; font-family: monospace;">${target.hex}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.76rem; color: #475569; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px dashed #e2e8f0;">
          <span>Brightness: <strong>${(target.bright * 100).toFixed(0)}%</strong></span>
          <span>Vibrancy: <strong>${(target.sat * 100).toFixed(0)}%</strong></span>
          <span>Contrast: <strong>${(target.contrast * 100).toFixed(0)}%</strong></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top: 12px; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b; text-align: center;">
        💡 <em>Click any similar cover to inspect it</em>
      </div>
    `;

    // Filter candidate pool by scope
    let pool = albumData;
    if (scope === "same") {
      pool = pool.filter(a => a.genre === target.genre);
      if (matchPoolLabel) matchPoolLabel.textContent = `Within ${target.genre} (${pool.length} Albums)`;
    } else {
      if (matchPoolLabel) matchPoolLabel.textContent = `Across All Genres (${pool.length} Albums)`;
    }

    const candidates = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) {
      const a = pool[i];
      if (a.id === target.id) continue;

      const dColor = Math.sqrt(
        Math.pow(a.r - target.r, 2) +
        Math.pow(a.g - target.g, 2) +
        Math.pow(a.b - target.b, 2) +
        Math.pow(a.sat - target.sat, 2)
      ) / 2.0;
      const colorSim = Math.max(0, 1 - dColor);

      const dDesign = Math.sqrt(
        Math.pow(a.bright - target.bright, 2) +
        Math.pow(a.contrast - target.contrast, 2)
      ) / 1.414;
      const designSim = Math.max(0, 1 - dDesign);

      const overallSim = 0.5 * colorSim + 0.5 * designSim;

      candidates.push({
        ...a,
        colorSim,
        designSim,
        overallSim
      });
    }

    if (metric === "color") {
      candidates.sort((x, y) => y.colorSim - x.colorSim);
    } else if (metric === "design") {
      candidates.sort((x, y) => y.designSim - x.designSim);
    } else {
      candidates.sort((x, y) => y.overallSim - x.overallSim);
    }

    const mostList = candidates.slice(0, count);
    const leastList = candidates.slice(-count).reverse();

    mostCards.innerHTML = mostList.map(item => renderCard(item, target, metric, true)).join("");
    leastCards.innerHTML = leastList.map(item => renderCard(item, target, metric, false)).join("");

    // Update Head-to-Head Visual Inspector with #1 match
    if (mostList.length > 0) {
      updateInspector(target, mostList[0]);
    }
  }

  window.selectAlbumByName = selectAlbumByName;

  // Search input event
  if (searchInput) {
    searchInput.addEventListener("change", function() {
      const val = searchInput.value.trim();
      const match = albumData.find(a => `${a.artist} - ${a.album}`.toLowerCase() === val.toLowerCase() || a.album.toLowerCase() === val.toLowerCase());
      if (match) {
        selectAlbumByName(match.artist, match.album);
        searchInput.value = "";
      }
    });
  }

  genrePicker.addEventListener("change", function() {
    populateArtists(genrePicker.value);
    populateAlbumsForArtist(artistPicker.value);
    updateDisplay();
  });

  artistPicker.addEventListener("change", function() {
    populateAlbumsForArtist(artistPicker.value);
    updateDisplay();
  });

  albumPicker.addEventListener("change", updateDisplay);
  metricPicker.addEventListener("change", updateDisplay);
  scopePicker.addEventListener("change", updateDisplay);
  countPicker.addEventListener("change", updateDisplay);

  // Palette Pills Filtering
  palettePills.forEach(pill => {
    pill.addEventListener("click", function() {
      palettePills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove("active"));
      pill.classList.add("active");
      activePaletteFilter = pill.getAttribute("data-palette");
      populateArtists(genrePicker.value);
      populateAlbumsForArtist(artistPicker.value);
      updateDisplay();
    });
  });

  // Surprise Me Button
  if (surpriseBtn) {
    surpriseBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
      let pool = albumData;
      if (genrePicker.value !== "all") {
        pool = pool.filter(a => a.genre === genrePicker.value);
      }
      if (activePaletteFilter !== "all") {
        const palPool = pool.filter(a => a.palette === activePaletteFilter);
        if (palPool.length > 0) pool = palPool;
      }
      const randomAlbum = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
      selectAlbumByName(randomAlbum.artist, randomAlbum.album);
    });
  }

  populateArtists("all", "Taylor Swift");
  populateAlbumsForArtist("Taylor Swift", "Lover");
  updateDisplay();
}

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initAlbumComparison);
} else {
  initAlbumComparison();
}
</script>
```
